programme.desc: 一場祖孫大戰，正式開打！彼得與阿公艾德原本感情很好，直到阿公要住進他的房間由於阿嬤過世後，年邁的阿公單獨生活出現狀況，他的駕照因此被吊銷，彼得的媽媽決定讓阿公住進家中，住進彼得的房間，彼得因此被迫搬進陰森的閣樓不滿的彼得，計畫要搶回自己的房間，他想了一連串詭計，但阿公艾德也不是省油的燈，他決定接招，並見招拆招

programme.title: 終極殺陣2-雷霆霹靂
programme.desc: 丹尼爾在女友莉莉的安排下，將與她的將軍父親相見，卻因車上乘客臨時生產而遲到，幸好，丹尼爾機智扭轉一切，並因將軍座車被撞毀，臨時擔任將軍司機，意外與日本國防部長相見歡，隨後因部長慘遭日本黑道挾持，而與剛取駕照的警察好友艾米里一同追緝

programme.title: 絕地任務
programme.desc: 位於舊金山灣外海的惡魔島，在1963年前曾以嚴密的警衛措施，成為全美設計最精實的監獄，宣稱無人能從中逃獄監獄廢棄後，惡魔島成了觀光勝地，每日都有遊客湧進嚐試坐牢的滋味，然而現在卻落在軍方恐怖份子的手裡，成為他們臨時的基地！

programme.title: 來去歐洲逛市場
programme.desc: 現代人的觀光旅遊，從名勝古蹟到巷弄街道，從人氣餐廳到傳統市集，若要徹底融入並瞭解這個城市的風貌，你一定要走一趟當地市場市場販賣著新鮮蔬果各類肉品雜糧乾貨甚至當地特色的熟食小吃，充滿美味之外，更富有人情味 來去歐洲逛市場介紹了歐洲城市最著名的市場，帶領大家探索這些市集產品和攤販，本次介紹的市場有拉脫維亞首都里加的中央市場義大利佛羅倫斯的中央市場法國西南部土魯斯的雨果市場克羅埃西亞首都札格勒布的朵拉茲市場德國夫來堡的明斯特市場 你喜歡逛市場嗎？市場所販賣的生鮮肉品與蔬菜水果，最能代表當地與時節的特色，以在地美食來認識一個城市，絕對是令人記憶深刻的一趟美妙饗宴之旅！

programme.desc: 健康好生活從最基本的健康飲食著手，詳細探討人體所需之各大營養素，運用時令的當季食材，做出營養均衡又美味的家常料理！而在節目中的台灣各專科百大名醫，則是透過分享在醫療工作上的實際案例，說明各種疾病的症狀與預防的重要性！

programme.title: 聚焦2.0
programme.desc: 無論是身體的痠痛病症，或是心理的躁鬱焦慮，透過每集邀請專業醫療菁英，知名人物現身說法，為您的健康把關，適合銀髮族和為人子女，每周一起坐下來觀看的知識型節目

programme.title: 百變智多星
programme.desc: 韓星代表專門戶梁赫群，益智鬼靈精傻妞葉欣眉，兩人合作無間智多星主題短劇爆笑開場超直白訪談笑料不斷字助猜體驗文學之美知識淘汰郎刺激中長智慧決戰168誰能闖關成功拿十萬

programme.title: 台灣向錢衝
programme.desc: 沒有不景氣，只有不爭氣，吳宣儀主播深入台灣各地，找出值得被鼓勵，應該被報導的小人物創業故事，危機就是轉機，轉念就能成願，觀眾可以從中學習成功祕訣，全民一起拚經濟

programme.title: 樂活SO MUCH
programme.desc: 節目將主題式介紹探討各種飲食習慣保健養生運動休閒民生必需永續環保等，各種國人關心的樂活新資訊，透過與專家來賓之間妙語如珠的互動，讓觀眾朋友一同感受快樂用心過生活，其實就是那麼的簡單

programme.title: 樂活SO MUCH
programme.desc: 節目將主題式介紹探討各種飲食習慣保健養生運動休閒民生必需永續環保等，各種國人關心的樂活新資訊，透過與專家來賓之間妙語如珠的互動，讓觀眾朋友一同感受快樂用心過生活，其實就是那麼的簡單

programme.title: 台灣壹百種味道第3季
programme.desc: 餐廳的主廚路邊推攤的小車媽媽桌上的菜餚東西料理異國風情時尚美味精緻饗宴...，台灣文化融合了外來移民的多樣性，四百年來五味雜陳，用味道記錄在地故事用感動記憶美食溫度酸甜苦辣五味人生台灣壹百種味道

programme.title: 健康好生活

programme.title: 星奇網事之網食
programme.desc: 最Kuso的美食資訊綜藝節目，推薦每星期網路熱搜的美食小吃，不管是早餐中餐晚餐加宵夜，還是甜點冰品下午茶，用大吃大喝的方式 帶你找回看電視的純粹享受

programme.title: 富貴門
programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.title: 健康好自在

programme.title: 美味So Much

programme.title: 健康好生活
programme.desc: 健康好生活從最基本的健康飲食著手，詳細探討人體所需之各大營養素，運用時令的當季食材，做出營養均衡又美味的家常料理！而在節目中的台灣各專科百大名醫，則是透過分享在醫療工作上的實際案例，說明各種疾病的症狀與預防的重要性！

programme.title: 百變智多星
programme.desc: 韓星代表專門戶梁赫群，益智鬼靈精傻妞葉欣眉，兩人合作無間智多星主題短劇爆笑開場超直白訪談笑料不斷字助猜體驗文學之美知識淘汰郎刺激中長智慧決戰168誰能闖關成功拿十萬

programme.title: 富貴門
programme.desc: 沙富來羅嘉良父母早亡，貧困交加中把弟弟沙寶來馬國明帶大；為生存在馬來西亞當老千機緣巧合下，他盜用了卓祟禧私生子卓一鳴的身份，與視他為親弟弟的大哥卓一元呂良偉回到香港進入卓家，搖身一變成為豪門二少爺然而在他未冒認身分之前，曾邂逅卓家千金卓一心袁詠儀，並兩人互生情愫，這短暫的浪漫，讓卓一心痛苦不堪，即欲斬斷這假不倫戀卓家上下從未懷?沙富來身分，極力想補償這個受苦多年的兒子，讓沙富來得到他本來失落的家庭溫暖，也讓他享受著金錢和權力的巨大誘惑，漸漸陷入貪婪恐懼嫉妒的人性試煉...

programme.desc: 經營雪濃湯店的單親媽媽朴善子（金海淑 飾），含辛茹苦將三個女兒撫養長大大女兒姜美善（裕善 飾）是標準的職業婦女，在蠟燭兩頭燒的職場與家庭間疲於奔命，不僅要應付強勢挑剔的婆婆，還得將年幼的女兒託付給娘家媽媽照顧二女兒姜美莉（金素妍 飾）是擁有高學歷與高薪的大企業行銷部長，為了不讓母親操心，美莉拚命工作，但在遇上新進職員韓泰柱（洪宗玄 飾）後，不僅感情迎來轉變，隱藏在身世背後與親生母親的複雜糾葛也逐漸浮上檯面小女兒姜美慧（金荷景 飾）曾是拿過文學獎的天才小說家，如今卻陷入漫長的創作低潮，只能暫時在媽媽的湯店裡幫忙打雜，尋找人生的下一個方向母女間時而爭吵時而相依為命的深厚羈絆，最堅強的後盾，就是媽媽?

programme.title: 摩登如來神掌

programme.title: 刀鋒劍客

programme.title: 氣象戰
programme.desc: 當地球上的天候已呈現失控狀態時，人類能依靠天候控制衛星來控制天候但某日，該衛星竟因未知原因而發生故障，使得地球上的天候發生暴走，各種毀滅性的天災降臨城市造成嚴重災害此時，唯一能阻止這一切的是一對兄弟衛星工程師，他們在行動的同時也意外發現到一項刺殺美國總統的陰謀正在醞釀

programme.title: 印第安納瓊斯-命運輪盤
programme.desc: 年事已高的考古冒險家瓊斯博士正準備迎接退休生活，他的教女海倫娜卻找到一件足以改變歷史的命運輪盤；為了避免神器落入惡人之手，印第安納將展開他人生最後一次冒險！

programme.title: 天作之合
programme.desc: 達珂塔強生飾演在紐約打拼，充滿抱負的年輕戀愛顧問露西，想不到戰無不勝的她，在一場婚禮遇到了業界傳說中的獨角獸，眾人幻想中的黃金單身漢，擁有名車和一千兩百萬美金的豪宅，幽默風趣又有品味，簡直完美但是在命運的作弄下，仍在為五斗米折腰的前男友，卻在此時又闖進她的人生，當我看著妳的臉，我看到皺紋和長得很像妳的小孩一直深愛她的前男友，讓露西開始重新思考人生的價值，愛情婚姻物質和現實

programme.title: 0.0赫茲
programme.desc: 我們欲想窺看那未知的世界，但它們早已經在某處窺看著我們 沒有不能被證實的靈異現象！0.0赫茲是個專門研究超自然現象的神祕社團，五個成員前往一處知名廢棄凶宅進行探險，測試當腦波與0.0赫茲同步時，是否真能召喚到鬼魂現身並接收來自靈界的訊息，殊不知卻引發一連串無法停止的靈異現象，不斷襲擊他們

programme.title: 最初的晚餐
programme.desc: 麟太郎（染谷將太 飾）和姐姐美也子（戶田惠梨香 飾）?了父親（永瀨正敏 飾）的葬禮返回家鄉，在守靈夜開始之前，母親秋子卻（齊藤由貴 飾）取消了所有的餐點並親自下廚隨著秋子端出一道道熟悉的料理，全家人回想起20年前，新媽媽秋子帶著大哥哥舜（窪塚洋介 飾）加入後五人一起生活的點滴，無論是曾經一起出遊的快樂回憶或是為了習慣差異出現的種種摩擦，不僅讓麟太郎他們重新思考家人的定義，更想起15年前，哥哥舜在一夜之間離家後再也沒回家的往事

programme.title: 地球過後
programme.desc: 地球毀滅的一千年後，人類被迫離開地球遷往諾瓦星球定居傳奇艦長西佛雷吉威爾史密斯 飾演剛從銀河系完成任務，準備返家照顧久未謀面的13歲兒子奇泰雷吉杰登史密斯 飾演 一場行星風暴卻摧毀了他們的太空船，雷吉父子被迫緊急降落面目全非而充滿危險的地球奇泰因父親西佛重傷臥倒於座艙奄奄一息，必須盡快修復飛船與勇敢跨越未知領域發出求救訊號，同時，他也必須面對已在地球上進化的各種可怕生物以及兇猛的外星怪獸...從小即渴望與父親一樣勇敢的奇泰，如何衝破父子間的隔閡化解致命困境，找到回家的路？

programme.title: 頭文字D

programme.title: 蜘蛛人-離家日

programme.title: 一級玩家

programme.title: 甄心分享小琳鐺

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記

programme.title: 初次為了愛
programme.desc: 單親媽媽李智安獨自扶養女兒長大，當醫學生女兒的人生出現轉折，母女來到海邊小鎮展開新生活命運讓她與初戀柳正碩重逢，塵封多年的感情再次萌芽，而兩人的下一代也悄悄譜出青春戀曲一段關於親情初戀與第二人生的療癒故事，就此展開．．．

programme.title: 長歌行
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 鍾馗誅妖傳
programme.desc: 唐朝時期妖怪肆虐，天神因而封印妖王沐風的妖力，使其無法作亂妖王的伴侶，千年花妖風四娘，為了解除封印，便到處尋找捉妖天師鍾馗的下落面對強妖來襲，鍾馗為了保護百姓，想出一招險記來對付風四娘

programme.title: 神鬼高校
programme.desc: 看似平凡的高中校園裡，有一個惡名昭彰的四年九班，裡面盡是一些三年內畢不了業的問題學生，其中又以綽號為大麻陽偉麥基和香香這三男一女為首，到處惹麻煩，以捉弄老師欺負同學破壞校園秩序，是校園裡最叫人頭痛的四個學生一次意外中，不慎炸傷了班導師顏惜嬌，惜嬌情商男朋友甄健代課學生們摩拳擦掌準備要好好對付新來的代課老師，殊不知這次來的可是個不好惹的狠角色

programme.title: 我的老婆是老大3-韓語
programme.desc: 阿玲是香港最強的黑道組織頭目林會長的女兒，由於組織間的勢力衝突，林會長不得不送阿玲去韓國東方派楊會長的地盤上暫避風頭，而楊會長對此事也甚為重視，特意派出組織裏的3號人物基哲負責保護阿玲的安全然而無巧不成書的是基哲一行人並不知道阿玲的真正身份把阿玲當成了觀光的遊客無比傲慢，而身份大揭開後則是無比驚恐 中國話講的半通不通的基哲緊急招聘延邊女孩延熙作翻譯，而延熙夾在這兩個劍撥弩張火氣沖天中的黑道人物之間，誰也不敢得罪，只能憑主觀翻譯，笑料百出可是一直要取阿玲性命甚至跨國追蹤的殺手們的到來使阿玲的性命危在旦夕，而她身邊的所有人也被牽連

programme.title: 血滴子
programme.desc: 消失於中國歷史的10大暗器之首，清朝血滴子暗殺部隊，唯一終極任務就是取下你的人頭！ 反清復明組織牧人日漸強大，以天狼為其首領的 黃曉明飾嚴重威脅清朝盛世，清朝雍正皇帝與兒子乾隆為剷除此勢力，為此培養以血滴子為兵器的特種暗殺部隊從小即接受專業訓練的部隊精英，擅長操作從未有人見其樣貌的神祕飛天暗器血滴子，此兵器能來無影去無蹤的取人首級而瞬間致死，被殺者往往連自己怎麼死的都不曉得血滴子隊長冷（阮經天飾）奉朝廷之命率領率領陳泰蒲巴甲飾 胡圖高天飾穆森李宇春飾十三井柏然飾布喀周一圍飾阿蘇郭鵬飾共7名高手，執行朝廷反清異己的秘密任務，眼看殺人於無形的血滴子天團即將面對史上最強宿敵，從未失手的他們，卻料想不到陷入腹背受敵的陰謀之中，因而從此改寫清朝的命運

programme.title: 千王
programme.desc: 在千王的世界裡，知人知面不知心，愈是靦腆有禮，愈要小心提防千術高手黃上千擊敗台灣泰斗，二人結下仇怨由於一場騙局，黃與星洲富婆惺惺相識，並決定合謀為民徐害，以美人局騙去貴利龍二百萬，不料貴利龍請來高手要扳回一城.....

programme.title: 嚦咕嚦咕新年財
programme.desc: 德華（劉德華飾）天生喜愛打牌，以打牌維生，牌技和牌品俱佳，足跡踏遍各大小屋?，人稱麻將大俠詠琪（梁詠琪飾）是德華的舊女友，因牌品差遭德華狠撇，卻對德華戀戀不捨，常以不同的身份和形象出現糾纏著德華，令德華不勝其煩 另一方面，德華多年前因打麻將以致債台高築連累家庭，弟弟天樂（古天樂飾）因此仇視德華而且極度憎恨麻將，自此與母親（黃文慧飾）相依為命而且兄弟老死不相往來天樂憑一己實力圖強讀書希望為母親帶來安穩生活，可惜在經濟不景氣下失業且變成負資產，母親更患上了阿茲海默症，德華以打麻將替母醫病之餘，決重新擔起這頭家 一回，天樂被青雲（劉青雲飾）一伙人詐騙輸光，德華為弟弟出頭找青雲出氣，後來青雲牌技不如德華大敗，青雲欲拜德華為師但被拒時詠琪隆胸後又再出現找德華，但再次被拒愛，悲憤之下詛咒德華一世摸爛牌另一方面，青雲卻看中詠琪，對詠琪展開追求，詠琪為刺激德華而

programme.title: 新龍門客棧:44
programme.desc: 明朝後期，內憂外患，東有倭寇侵擾，西有異族覬覦沉迷于煉丹修道的老皇上迫於百官壓力，決定立皇長子賢王為太子，並宣召賢王的岳父鎮守西北的老英王前來參加冊立大典這引起強烈渴求儲君之位的皇四子敬王及其政治盟友東廠大太監曹少欽的不滿，暗中策劃陰謀...

programme.title: 倚天屠龍記:42
programme.desc: 故事主要圍繞著武當派張翠山與明教殷素素之子張無忌（由曾舜晞飾演）的成長歷程，講述了江湖上各大門派的恩怨情仇，以及張無忌與峨眉派周芷若元朝郡主趙敏之間的複雜愛情糾葛

programme.title: 導火線
programme.desc: 來自緬甸的黑幫三兄弟：大哥阿渣霸氣縱橫二哥Tony冷靜狡猾三弟阿虎打遍天下，於黑道日益壯大，卻想不到身邊保鑣華生竟是警方的臥底重案組督察馬軍為人執著火爆，就在他展開拘捕行動之際，華生的臥底身份被揭穿險些送命！馬軍將阿渣拘捕，Tony與阿虎敗走潛逃，將指證阿渣的證人通通消滅，華生女友更被擄走

programme.title: 唐人街探案3
programme.desc: 繼曼谷紐約之後，東京再出大案唐人街神探唐仁（王寶強 飾）秦風（劉昊然 飾）受偵探野田昊（妻夫木聰 飾）邀請前往破案CRIMASTER世界偵探排行榜中的偵探們聞訊也前往東京，加入挑戰，而排名第一Q的現身，讓這個大案更加撲朔迷離，一場亞洲最強神探之間的較量即將爆笑展開

programme.title: 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: 清乾隆年間，紅花會老舵主於萬亭病逝，命其義子陳家洛接替總舵主之位初入江湖的陳家洛得知紅花會多個分舵遭神祕組織襲擊，四當家文泰來下落不明在打探訊息過程中，陳家洛與志在福王寶藏的舞女玉如意達成交易兩人從杭州經歷司錢經歷著手，與三當家趙半山四嫂駱冰等人一同救出了文泰來原來文泰來手中掌握了一個更為驚天的秘密，由此引來了各方勢力的追殺，上演了一場江湖與朝堂的碟中諜面對情與義，陳家洛又該如何抉擇

programme.title: 長歌行:4
programme.desc: 原是永寧郡主的李長歌因玄武門之變父喪母亡，她僥倖逃出城，赴幽州求援；途中，偶遇化名秦准的草原部落特勤阿詩勒隼，兩人不打不相識，漸生英雄相惜之感長歌在幽州粉碎一場陰謀，但郡主的身份卻敗露，前往?州避禍長歌藏於?州太守公孫恆身邊，助其共抗草原勢力侵襲，卻未想到敵方將領阿詩勒隼竟是自己的舊識秦准

programme.title: 金孫
programme.desc: 純樸的鄉下因為跨國旅館投資案帶來的土地增值與觀光商機而全民動員唯一在這場狂想曲中保持冷靜的是養豬戶阿甘，單純的他只想著家裡母豬何時生豬仔，以及如何讓母親接受已過生育年紀的算命師女友 來自越南的金枝，為了給家鄉的孩子穩定生活，前來台灣嫁入甘家，在婆婆麗花眼中，金枝是滿足看護人手與傳宗接代的妙計，卻讓阿甘的生活陷入空前危機旅館建案的逼近讓鄉民陷入瘋狂，在這失控的鄉間，金枝跟阿甘都只渴求簡單的幸福，而這樣的幸福能不能有相同的答案？

programme.title: 97家有囍事
programme.desc: 老家大宅住著老老頭和三個兒子，有還有一個媳婦，老老頭妻子早逝，一邊要照顧生意，一邊還要撫育三個孩子，在一連串的家庭憂喜之事連連發生後，一家人的感情更加堅定不移溫馨感人，趣事橫生

programme.title: 警察故事續集
programme.desc: 皇家香港警察隊重案組警長陳家駒成功緝拿大毒梟朱滔搞垮其販毒集團後，卻因屢次違反上級命令嚴重破壞公物後遭到署長調職當交警期間，朱滔因身患絕症而只剩三個月生命，因此獲得保外就醫而走出法院，揚言要對家駒報復

programme.title: 警察故事三之超級警察
programme.desc: 講述了香港員警陳家駒與大陸女公安楊建華前往販毒集團臥底，在合作打擊毒梟過程中被識破身份，不得不與毒梟團夥周旋，最終剷除販毒集團的故事...

programme.title: 功夫廚師
programme.desc: 地表上最偉大的功夫廚師范古大師，在越南河粉料理界中備受尊敬范古的河粉料理因完美結合功夫與美味食譜成為傳說他有兩個女兒，大女兒可可堅強勇敢，小女兒范妮美麗溫柔范古最出色的學生吳和古，為了得到秘方和范妮的愛，展開了一場緊張刺激的戰鬥25年後，這場傳奇之戰在古家的杜安和吳家的特杭之間再次上演這場戰爭不僅建立在上一代錯綜複雜的關係之上，還有來自外部試圖奪取秘方的勢力這個秘方真的值得一切犧牲嗎？

programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.desc: 科技罪案組高級督察司徒忠督察蕭美婷在工作上亦師亦友，屢破各種電話網絡科技騙案；司徒忠在偵查一宗網上情緣案件的過程中，重遇前度女友張慧，碰巧她與丈夫沈子浩關係破裂，司徒忠與張慧愛火得以重燃與此同時，倫敦金騙案鬧得滿城風雨，而子浩與張慧亦牽連其中，危機四伏......

programme.title: 舞動全城:1
programme.desc: 醉心舞蹈的李心盈廖碧兒一心投考香港舞蹈團，卻在考試前在超市遇上哥哥李力強黎耀祥和同事程嘉俊馬浚偉，盈不慎被俊的手推車絆倒，令盈在選拔試中失準，錯失機會

programme.title: 翻生武林:4
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 棟仁的時光:16
programme.desc: 一個吻可以改寫甚麼？一個媽媽的吻別，令閏秒出生就夭折的曾棟仁奇蹟地活下來一個急救之吻，救護員程敏琦令棟仁得以續命，讓他知道自己有偷時間續命的能力，也讓敏琦昏睡兩日，錯過了自己的婚禮，未婚夫還離奇失蹤！一個借來的吻，同時感應到對方的想法或感受，令棟仁攀上事業高峰，並足以協助身邊人改寫命運：改善單親爸爸張潮岸的父女關係激發廢青羅瑞楠的鬥志一個最後續命之吻，也是愛人敏琦奪命之吻，棟仁會如何抉擇？

programme.title: 踩過界2:18
programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.desc: 綽號盲俠的失明大律師文申俠（王浩信飾）擁有超強的四感，他聯同女師爺趙正妹（蔡思貝飾）私家偵探谷一夏（張振朗飾）為弱勢社群爭取公義，不惜採取踩界手法大律師邵美娜（張曦雯飾）主動接近申俠，二人及後會於法庭對壘，在美娜背後支援的還有其師父簡紹宏（秦沛飾） 申俠於多年前的實習期曾拜紹宏為師，期間卻因一宗無屍命案而師徒決裂；申俠提出新證據為被告上訴，與紹宏再次交鋒，引發連場惡鬥！美娜的出現，同時亦令申俠正妹一夏這個鐵三角組合的關係，產生微妙變化

programme.title: 翻生武林:5
programme.desc: 朝廷打壓武林，五大派被收編英雄名冊，交由東廠提督仇不群管治，江湖名存實亡，英雄不再！玉雲龍跟姐姐嬌鳳經營平安客棧，一直遠離武林中事但雲龍為奪舊愛艾冰冰芳心，決意逐鹿新晉英雄大賽，卻因揭發東廠黑幕被押入大牢嬌鳳為救雲龍，訛稱平安客棧暗藏異寶，招致各路隱世英雄齊集仇在心奉義父不群之命親近雲龍探查寶物，與雲龍漸生情愫，二人更無意中救出被困多年的武林盟主任我飛！沉睡多時的武林，可會因此翻生？

programme.title: 震震有詞
programme.desc: 很多人都說法律只保護懂法律的人，但法律其實不難懂，它甚至和你我的生活息息相關，無論是租屋購物婚姻家庭旅行等都可能扯上法律；一般人遇到了總是慌了手腳，不知如何處理甚至抱持著鴕鳥心態選擇置之不理，最後有可能造成更加難以收拾的局面！節目特別以專業律師團及藝人的精彩案例為主軸，透過他們親身經歷的真實故事，帶出一般民眾常見的法律困擾，讓觀眾在輕鬆的氛圍中了解及面對生活周遭的法律問題懂得保護自己，不再害怕法律

programme.desc: When the family that a man named Wu Jimmy Wang Yu marries into comes under repeated attack, he suspects that his in-laws are bandits. (当一个名叫武吉米王尤的家人被反复攻击时,他怀疑他的岳父是强盗.)

programme.title: The Sword of Swords ((剑来))
programme.desc: After a master passes on his magical weapon to his top student, a jealous rival goes and kidnaps the mans fiance. (一个师父把他的魔术武器交给了他的顶级学生后,一个嫉妒的对手走了去绑架男人的未婚夫.)

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes (许多香水的土地)
programme.desc: The Monk, Monkey, Friar Sand and Pig find themselves in a realm where women can only give birth to women unless loved by a man. (子,子,修道士沙子和猪发现自己处于一个领域,)

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby ((红孩儿))
programme.desc: Go on a quest with the Monkey King, Goddess of Mercy and Dragon Girl, as they battle Hung, the son of the Ox Demon to save Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim. (随着子王,慈悲女神和龙女神一起去探险,他们与雄牛恶魔的儿子洪战斗,)

programme.title: Love Without End 1961 ((不了情 1961))
programme.desc: This classic romance stars Linda Lin and Kwan Shan, capturing a touching love story between a famous nightclub singer and a young architect.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat ((罗小黑战记))
programme.desc: Director Chor Yuen reunites with novelist, Gu Long, and superstar, Ti Lung, in this exciting sequel to Clans of Intrigue. (导演Chor Yuen与小说家,古龙和超级明星,蒂隆,在这个令人兴奋的后续剧中重新相遇.)

programme.title: Dream of the Red Chamber1961
programme.desc: With a focus on the pampered teenaged Jia Bao Yu, believed to be of supernatural origins, this Chinese classic depicts the Jia familys rise and fall.

programme.title: The Killer ((杀手锏))
programme.desc: Starring Chin Han, Wang Ping and Tsung Hua, this movie revolves around the challenges that beset three sworn brothers and sisters. (电影中主演的是汉,王平和华.)

programme.title: Tales of Larceny ((牛鬼蛇神))
programme.desc: Be tickled by the slippery efforts of three pickpockets, so adept at their chosen skill that they even manage to fleece three beauties of their underwear! (那些有精力挑选的钱包手,)

programme.title: Clan of the White Lotus ((洪文定三破白莲教))
programme.desc: A hero Gordon Liu Chia hui must learn Embroidery Fist and acupuncture to counter a villains Lo Lieh deadly fight techniques. (一个英雄戈登··奇亚·胡必须学习刺拳和针,以抵制恶棍洛·莱赫的致命战斗技巧.)

programme.title: The Snake Prince ((蛇王子))
programme.desc: Attracted by a sensual rain dance performed by three tribeswomen, three snake siblings set in motion a tale of romance, lust and tragedy. (由于三位部落妇女的情感舞蹈吸引了三位蛇兄弟,)

programme.title: Ambush ((伏击))
programme.desc: This intriguing action flick blends westerns and detective films in its martial arts mainline, depicting a tale of vigilante justice versus the law. (这部令人兴奋的动作片将西方和侦探电影融合到武术的主线上,)

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛出獄記))
programme.desc: After Ah Niu gets out of jail, he gets involved again with his crooked Uncle Chou and caught in other rackets and silly situations. (子从监狱出来后,他又和子在一起,)

programme.title: The Blood Brothers ((The Blood 兄弟))
programme.desc: A pillar of the Qing establishment kills his blood brother to steal the mans wife. Also starring David Chiang. (清政的支柱杀死了他的血兄弟,为了偷窃他的妻子.)

programme.title: Moods of Love ((风花雪月))
programme.desc: How far would you go for love? Or lust? These are the questions posed in two, sinfully entertaining Sung Dynasty tales that comprise this film. (朝的两个故事中提出的这些问题,)

programme.title: The Female Prince ((这个王妃有点萌))
programme.desc: Ivy Ling Po and Chin Han return with a Huangmei Opera classic, depicting a loving couple whose marriage is being poisoned by the husbands stepmother. (爱文波和汉带来了黄美歌剧经典, 描绘着一个热爱的夫妇,)

programme.title: Duel for Gold ((火并))
programme.desc: Famed director Chor Yuen has three pairs of cunning crooks on a quest to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House but one is undercover. (著名的导演乔有三对的骗子在寻找从福莱财务馆偷走一百万金,)

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne ((香江花月夜))
programme.desc: Three sisters the quietest and most filial of whom is played by Cheng Pei Pei attempt to sing and dance their way to happiness. (佩佩饰演的三个姐妹,最安静和最亲属的,)

programme.title: King Gambler ((千王之王重出江湖))
programme.desc: In this lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, two cardsharks spar in a battle of wits and fists to become king of the casino. (在这场博电影狂热的前中,两个卡在智慧和拳头的战斗中成为场的国王.)

programme.title: Lets Fall in Love (让我们爱上)
programme.desc: Pressured by his parents to marry prior to taking over his fathers business, Guan rejects every girl they find but then, he stumbles upon the perfect one? (他被父母压迫嫁给,然后接管父亲的业务,)

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers (伟大的漫游者)
programme.desc: Share the adventures of patriot Chu Tieh-hsieh and his three comrades, who head out with the aim of relieving Mongolian invaders of their ill-gotten gains. (让我们分享爱国者楚蒂希希和他的三位同志的冒险,)

programme.title: We Love Millionaires ((我爱金龟婿))
programme.desc: 3 beautiful salesgirls masquerade as high society belles in a bid to realize their dreams of marrying millionaires. (三位漂亮的卖家扮演高层士, 为了实现他们嫁给百万富翁的梦想.)

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2 ((射雕英雄传续集))
programme.desc: In this Brave Archer sequel, Kuo Tsings Alexander Fu Sheng love for Huang Yung Niu Niu is challenged by Ouyang Fung. (在这部勇敢的弓箭手续集中,郭清斯亚历山大福盛对黄永纽纽纽的爱情被乌阳丰挑战.)

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins ((阿牛发达记))
programme.desc: When a bag of jewels falls from the sky, thats just the start of Ah Nius misadventures involving a brothel, a disastrous wedding night and the cops! (当一袋珠宝从天空上落下来,这只是阿尼斯的开始, 涉及一个妓院,)

programme.title: High Forces ((危机航线))
programme.desc: An A380 airliner is hijacked by gunmen on its maiden flight. Among the passengers is a security expert, whose daughter is one of the captives. Can he save all the passengers and avert the crisis? (乘客们在首次飞行时,一架A380航班被枪手劫持.其中一名安全专家,他的女儿是被俘的.)

programme.title: Lost Love ((夕笛))
programme.desc: Mei tries to get over her young sons death by becoming a foster parent. Her dedication to the children leads her to neglect her husband. Will the couple be able to salvage their relationship? (梅试图通过成为抚养父母来克服她的小儿子的死亡.她对孩子的奉献使她忽视她的丈夫.)

programme.title: Wu Kong ((悟空传))
programme.desc: Eddie Peng charms as possibly the most handsome Monkey King alongside Shawn Yue Ni Ni in this fantasy-action-adventure film.

programme.title: Hong Kong Family ((奸人世家))
programme.desc: A family torn apart 8 years ago during a disastrous winter solstice dinner reunites when their cousin returns home from England, hoping to mend relations after things had fallen apart. (一个8年前在一个灾难性的冬日变节晚餐中被撕裂的家庭,)

programme.title: Chilli Laugh Story ((阖家辣))
programme.desc: Coba turns his mothers chili sauce into a trendy commodity during the pandemic, with the help of the whole family. The business booms online, bringing them unexpected success and unity. (科巴在整个家庭的帮助下,在疫情期间,把他的母亲的汁变成了流行商品.)

programme.title: Tiger Wolf Rabbit ((浴火之路))
programme.desc: Three devastated parents unite after their children are abducted. Driven by grief and rage, they hunt down a brutal trafficking syndicate to bring their children home alive.

programme.title: The Kid From The Big Apple ((我来自纽约))
programme.desc: This heartwarming box office smash captures how a little Chinese girl, raised in New York, begins to discover her roots when she visits Malaysia.

programme.title: Ne Zha 2 ((哪吒之魔童闹海))
programme.desc: After a catastrophe, the souls of Ne Zha and Ao Bing are saved, but their bodies will soon dissipate. Master Tai Yi seeks to restore them with the Seven-Coloured Lotus, hoping to change their destiny. (师试图用七色莲花恢复他们,希望改变他们的命运.)

programme.title: Crypto Storm ((反贪风暴之加密危机))
programme.desc: ICAC officer Lok sets up a special team to investigate a corruption case involving a banks top executives use of cryptocurrency to manipulate the trading market. (国际货币监管局官员洛克成立了一个专门团队调查涉及银行高管使用加密货币来操纵交易市场的腐败案件.)

programme.title: Everything Under Control ((超神经械劫案下))
programme.desc: During a diamond heist, Jelly steals the loot and flees, with his other cohorts hot on his heel. They stumble onto a remote village with strange villagers and mysterious eerie occurrences. (在钻石抢劫期间,杰利偷走了物品,他和其他队友们在他的脚上.)

programme.title: Love After Love ((爱在狱外))
programme.desc: Marking the 3rd Eileen Chang adaptation directed by Ann Hui, this film is set in pre-WW2 Hong Kong, where a young girl ends up working for her aunt seducing rich powerful men.

programme.title: Honey Money Phony ((“骗骗”喜欢你2))
programme.desc: Deceived by a romantic scam and burdened with a massive debt, Lin partners with con artist Ouyang to reclaim her money. Together, they defy the odds and discover an unexpected love in the process. (林被一个浪漫的骗局欺骗,并被巨额债务负担,她与骗子奥扬合作,要求她收回钱.)

programme.title: Life Must Go On ((The Show Must Go On（1991年皇后乐队演唱歌曲）))
programme.desc: When the midnight gymnasium programme for wayward teenage girls is at risk of closing down due to funding, social worker Yanki puts together a dodgeball team to compete in a match to save it. (当那些反逆的青少年女孩的午夜体育馆计划因资金而面临关闭的风险时,社会工作者Yanki组建了一个球队,)

programme.title: Wild City ((野性新加坡))
programme.desc: Hong Kong director Ringo Lam returns after seven years with this action drama in which a cop-turned-bar-owner his brother are pulled into a gang war.

programme.title: Article 20 ((第二十条))
programme.desc: Prosecutor Han Ming battles a case of intentional injury, risking all for justice. In a gripping finale, he transforms it into a fight for fairness, defending what is right. (检察官汉明在一场故意伤害案件中,为正义冒着一切风险.)

programme.title: Endgame ((终局))
programme.desc: A remake from the Japanese movie Key of Life, Andy Lau, Xiao Yang and Wan Qian stars in this action comedy about the switched identities of an unsuccessful actor a professional assassin.

programme.title: Panda Plan ((熊猫计划之部落奇遇记))
programme.desc: Legendary kung fu star Jackie Chan adopts a panda names Hu Hu. When a crime syndicate places a bounty on the panda, Jackie, his agent, and Hu Hus caretaker embark on a quest to outsmart the villains. (传奇功夫明星杰基采用了一只熊猫叫胡胡. 当犯罪集团给熊猫提供奖励时,杰基,他的代理人和胡胡监护人开始寻求超越恶棍的任务.)

programme.title: Once in a Blue Moon ((望月))
programme.desc: Mei Zhens family appears to get along but harbours secrets - she struggles at work, her brother hides his separation and their mother fears her past will affect them. Can they overcome these hurdles? (梅斯家人似乎很好处,但却隐藏着秘密 - - 她在工作中苦苦苦,她的兄弟隐藏了分手,他们的母亲担心她的过去会影响他们.)

programme.title: Man On the Edge ((边缘行者))
programme.desc: A triad leader assigns his right-hand man Ah Lok to take charge of the drug trafficking business, but Ah Lok is actually an undercover policeman who unveils a shocking political conspiracy. (一位三级领袖将他的右手阿洛克派去负责毒品贩运业务,)

programme.title: Good Game ((高手过招))
programme.desc: A desperate internet cafe owner recruits his daughter, a washed-up action star and a failed pro gamer to form a ragtag esports teamall for a HK500k tournament and one last, no-regrets shot. (一位绝望的互联网咖啡馆老板招募了他的女儿,一个流的动作明星和一个失败的职业游戏玩家,)

programme.title: The Prosecutor ((辩护))
programme.desc: A young man is wrongly convicted of drug trafficking. A former cop turned prosecutor believes in his innocence and launches an investigation, risking his life and career to find the true perpetrator. (一个年轻人被错误地判有罪,因为贩毒,一名前警察变成了检察官,相信他无辜,并开始调查,冒着生命和职业生涯的危险,)

programme.title: Time Still Turns the Pages ((年少日记))
programme.desc: High school teacher Cheng finds a suicide note, triggering his childhood memories. He strives to prevent the suicide tragedy, while dealing with his wifes divorce request and his fathers illness. (高中老师发现了一张自杀笔记,激起了他的童年记忆.他努力防止自杀悲剧,同时处理他的妻子离婚请求和父亲的疾病.)

programme.title: New Frontiers in Chinese Sci-Fi Ep04 (科幻小说中新界限 Ep04)
programme.desc: The youth of a country is the future of that country. A series of documentaries focusing on the younger generation of China in which you get to see what they are achieving and what makes them tick! (纪录片系列讲述中国年轻人,)

programme.title: Tales in Light and Shadow

programme.title: Booked: First Day in S1 Ep13 (预订:第一天在S1 Ep13)

programme.title: River Monsters S1 Ep04 ((河中巨怪 S1 Ep04))

programme.title: Alaska: the Last Frontier S10 Ep07 ((家在阿拉斯加 S10 Ep07))
programme.desc: An earthquake strikes Homer, triggering a tsunami warning and evacuation.

programme.desc: Heather and Phil track reports of a bloodsucking Chupacabra terrorising eastern Texas, teaming up with a robotic hound to hunt the elusive creature.

programme.title: Dual Survival S4 Ep10 ((求生一加一 S4 Ep10))
programme.desc: Lost in a land that time forgot New Zealands Fjordland, Joe and Matt face a seemingly ordinary scenario but this time, theyve only got one chance to get out alive. (失落在一个曾经忘记的土地上, 乔和马特面临一个看似普通的场景,)

programme.title: Dual Survival S2 Ep04 ((求生一加一 S2 Ep04))

programme.title: Expedition X S6 Ep07 ((暗黑追谜探险队 S6 Ep07))
programme.desc: Phil and Heather travel to the location of the original Conjuring House to investigate a familys claims that similar dark paranormal activity is haunting their home. (菲尔和希瑟前往原始的魔术之家, 调查一个家庭的说法,)

programme.title: Exploring the Unknown With Wang Yibo S2 Ep05 ((探索新境 S2 Ep05))
programme.desc: Wang Yibo and Ryder Stroud arrive in Wyoming, soaking in Jackson Holes cowboy culture before reuniting with Jimmy Chin for new rock climbing challenges.

programme.title: Expedition Files S2 Ep14 ((追谜档案 S2 Ep14))

programme.title: Deadliest Catch S18 Ep05 ((渔人的搏斗 S18 Ep05))

programme.title: Deadliest Catch S19 Ep01 ((渔人的搏斗 S19 Ep01))

programme.title: Expedition X S6 Ep11 ((暗黑追谜探险队 S6 Ep11))

programme.desc: Josh Gates treks north of the Arctic Circle to search for the DNA of the long-extinct woolly mammoth. (乔希·盖茨走向北极圈寻找长期灭绝的羊毛猛的DNA.)

programme.title: Woman of the Night
programme.desc: The movie offers three stories of love and obsession. In the first tale, a young student with a voyeuristic habit spies on two of his female roommates. The second story follows an office manager who develops an infatuation for his secretary. The last story is a complex family drama about a debilitated father who forces his family to leave him.

programme.title: Temple Of The Red Lotus
programme.desc: A young guy Wu, heads off to the Dragon Valley to meet his childhood friend Lian Chu, who was promised to be his bride. When he arrives, he finds out that the family of his bride may not be an entirely honest bunch of people. Wu wishes to take Lian Chu with him, so he has no choice but to fight against her family

programme.title: The Sword of Swords
programme.desc: The Sword Master passes on his sword to his disciple Lin before he dies. However, Lin soon discovers that another disciple Fang also eyes the sword and plots to take it away from Lin, destroying his family and blinding him in the process. Finally, Lin battles Fang for revenge and vows to reclaim his sword.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: The Fantastic Magic Baby
programme.desc: The story is about the legendary Monkey King Liu Chung-chun teams up with Goddess of Mercy Chao Li-chuan and the Dragon Girl Lung Nu to battle the child god Hung Hai-erh Ting Hua-chung,son of the Ox Demon Hung Hai-erh to rescue Tang Tseng, the Holy Pilgrim Teng Chio-jen.

programme.title: Love without End
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: Legend of the Bat
programme.desc: It is rumoured that people can buy anything they desire on the mysterious Island of Bats so long as they have money. The charismatic swordsman Chu Liu Xiang and his friend travel to the island to seek answers but realize they are not the only ones who want to unveil the mystery of this place.

programme.title: The Dream of the Red Chamber
programme.desc: Adapted from the most widely read and filmed novel in Chinese history, this version is said to be the most successful one. Betty Lohs looks, demeanour and aura in her portrayal of Lin Dai Yu has won her the epithet Classic Beauty.

programme.title: The Killer
programme.desc: Hsieh Choun, the Black Dragon, is in trouble with the police since Wang Sien Tiens gang is helping them he is no longer free to conduct his drugs shipments out of the port freely as he used to. He buys more thugs and killers to dispose of the young upstart, and soon Wang is in dire straits, in the port of Hong Kong.

programme.title: Tales of Larceny
programme.desc: Connecting all the antics of bosses, monks, beggars, and thieves is the slippery and sinuous efforts of three pickpockets so adept at their chosen skill that they can even trick three beauties of their underwear without missing a step.

programme.title: Clan Of The White Lotus
programme.desc: The head of White Lotus Clan, Lo, is a highly skilled martial artist who supports the Qing government and helps destroy the rebellion group. Hung from Shaolin who kills Los brother, is being hunted and hides in another rebel Hus house. The clan attacks at night killing Hu and his sister, but Hung manages to get Hus pregnant wife to safety.

programme.title: The Snake Prince
programme.desc: The Snake Prince lives on the Snake Mountain of Kwangsi with other snakes and they have lived peacefully with humans for a thousand years. All things change however, when the Snake Prince falls in love with one of the three beauties performing a sensual rain dance in the nearby village one day, and decides to marry her at all costs...

programme.title: Ambush
programme.desc: Constable Wen Chao Fan and his father are framed for a jewel robbery they did not commit. On the run from the law and becoming a wanted fugitive, Wen must recover the jewels in order to clear his family name, but unfortunately he is not the only one seeking the stolen jewels...

programme.title: Return of the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This sequel makes for more bittersweet laughs and heart-wrenching misfortune, as Ah Niu gets out of the jail to find his true love becoming the wife of an abusive husband, and his uncle further exploits his naive nature.

programme.title: The Blood Brothers
programme.desc: The friendship of three sworn brothers, Zhang, Huang and Ma ends when Ma gives in to corruption and falls for Huangs wife, eventually leading to a bloody ending.

programme.title: Moods Of Love
programme.desc: This Song Dynasty period piece about how far one would go for love or lust has two tales. The first involves a devilish magistrate who tries to tempt a Buddhist monk out of his self-professed celibacy by hiring a pretty prostitute. The second is the tragic tale of an exploited young girl who is forced to work in an unscrupulous couples brothel.

programme.title: The Female Prince
programme.desc: Hsiaos stepmother frames her fianc Lung when he refuses to forfeit their engagement and sends him to prison. To save him, Hsiao disguises as Lung to take the Imperial exam and ranks first place. Impressed by Hsiao, the Emperor weds the Princess to him. When Hsiao comes clean on their wedding night, she persuades the Princess to follow a plan

programme.title: Duel For Gold
programme.desc: Six swordsmen, including two sisters and their husbands, a ranger and a security man, are trying to steal a million gold taels from the Fu Lai Treasury House, not knowing that one of them is actually an undercover hero. In their quest, they have to double-cross and outwit one another...

programme.title: Hong Kong Nocturne
programme.desc: This joyous, raucous, colorful tunefest showcases the little seen dancing talents of celebrated kung-fu swordswoman Cheng Pei-Pei, as one of 3 girls dancing their way to the top.

programme.title: King Gambler
programme.desc: This film was actually a lively forerunner to the gambling film craze, which eventually swept Asian cinema. Here, its cardsharp versus cardsharp with a lot more kung-fu action, in a battle of wits and fists to become the king of the casino. The double stings and triple crosses raise in complexity and imagination until what started as an unusual box office risk became a top ten hit of 1976.

programme.title: Lets Fall In Love
programme.desc: Da Yung, the son of a rich entrepreneur, meets Lian Lian, the niece of a kindergarten principal by chance. They fall into a misunderstanding on the first meeting, causing Da Yung to lose his wallet. Further misunderstanding occurs when he tries to get her to act as his fianc so as to drive away two women whom he does not like

programme.title: Magnificent Wanderers
programme.desc: Lin and his two friends are traveling patriots who vow to stand up against violence and fight for justice. They meet a rich young man Chu by chance one day and the four become best friends. When a foreign prince plots to possess Chus family fortune and goes after him, Lin and friends go all out to help Chu fight against the villain.

programme.title: We Love Millionaires
programme.desc: In this romantic comedy, three beautiful Hong Kong salesgirls travel to Osaka in Japan to pursue their dreams of marrying a rich man. They masquerade as high society debutantes and make their way to a posh resort to meet and woo millionaires or fake ones!.

programme.title: The Brave Archer 2
programme.desc: Knowing Guo Jing has won Huang Rongs hand in marriage using the kung fu learned from Jiu Yin manual, Ouyang Feng captures Huang and agrees to release her only if Guo can dictate the content of the manual. Will Guo give in to the threat?

programme.title: Big Times for the Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: Ah Niu finds a bag of jewels on the street and becomes rich. It is at this time that Uncle Zhou asks him to sign a contract to marry a girl, but it turns out to be a trap for Ah Niu to sell his house. In the end, Ah Niu becomes poor again

programme.title: On The Way
programme.desc: This large-scale tourism programme is designed to present the rich tourism resources in China and around the world.

programme.desc: CCTV brings you broadcasts of finely-produced artistic dramas that closely follow the pulse of the times.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Set in 1917, young Ip Man pursues his studies in Hong Kong. The school is held hostage on the day of an English speech competition, and as Ip Man decides to step up and fight the crisis, it is revealed that his master and his childhood friend are behind all this. Can he take them down and uphold justice?

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: Scholar Wang Huai Qing sells paintings to save his ailing wife. He is attacked by a bird demon along the way but is rescued by Fox demon Xiao Rong. To elude the pursuit, Wang brings Xiao Rong home, sparking a love triangle and at the same time, unfolding an impending love between human and demon.

programme.title: Forbidden City Cop
programme.desc: A wild and hilariously anachronistic tale of an imperial guard of the Forbidden City who has no martial arts abilities. When the emperor is abducted, he saved the day with his unusual hobby: tinkering with futuristic inventions!

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: A young girl encounters a novelist in a bar and quickly falls in love with him. However, it turns out she has fallen into a trap set up by the novelist and his ex-girlfriend who is a ghost with a disfigured face. The journey of revenge and ultimate terror has just begun!

programme.title: Song of the Assassins
programme.desc: A young assassin is assigned his first mission while secretly investigating the cause of his familys massacre years ago. During the mission, he finds himself entangled in a political conspiracy that has been planned for years and must use his skills as an assassin to face whatever comes his way.

programme.title: Love on Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Drunken Master
programme.desc: After provoking the son of a local tyrant, young Wong Fei Hung is sent by his father to train under Drunken Master Beggar So. When his father uncovers the tyrants plot to sell mines to the Japanese, he becomes a target for assassination. To save his father and stop the sale, Fei Hung must forge his own Drunken Fist style to defeat the killers.

programme.title: Lets Have a Baby
programme.desc: De Sheng and Wan Jun have been married for years, but are unable to conceive. Wan Jun decides to undergo artificial insemination in the States and finally gets pregnant. She meets her cousin from the States who stays temporarily in their house with them, and De Sheng begins to suspect that they are having an affair

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: A special agent from the Japanese National Security teams up with a skilled thief to find a pair of plates used to make counterfeit USD. However, a US Embassy representative appears and steals the plates, running away to Korea with them.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley is cursed by an evil spirit to not be able to approach any woman. When he falls in love with Siu Yu, Rileys mother decides to use her to help him vanquish the evil spirit. On their wedding night, Riley passes out after protecting Siu Yu from the attack of the evil spirit. Can the two finally break the curse?

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing tracks, but is subsequently entangled with loan sharks. Li becomes debt-laden while his sons are harassed by debt collectors, when more heart-wrenching events begin to unfold.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Mans matchless fighting skills are revered all over China. Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Ip Man is forced to leave his home and work to support his family. With only his martial arts skills, he reluctantly agrees to train others in the art of Wing Chun for self-defense.

programme.title: Legend Of The Dragon
programme.desc: A young man Lung leaves his rural home on a small island to seek fortune in Hong Kong. His uncle cons Lung to play in a snooker tournament using his fathers land as the bet. Lung lost the match but luckily, his childhood friend Momo encourages him to compete again using her land as the bet. Can he finally win his land back?

programme.title: Mr Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Buddhist monk and Taoist priest put aside their differences to take on vampires that have been struck by lightning and have now become a super powered threat to mankind.

programme.title: Maoshan Heavenly Master
programme.desc: Prisoner Chi flees away under Master Zhangs custody, causing the latter to be expelled from his clan. On his way to find Chi, Master Zhang arrives at a place where many people vanish for no reason. He soon discovers that it is Chi who captures them in his training to become a serpent demon. The war between human and demon has just begun!

programme.title: The Illegal Immigrant
programme.desc: This is a gritty and realistic Chinatown tale about the life of a Chinese illegal immigrant and his journey in New York. He is looking for a fake marriage with a girl so as to gain the right of abode there. Despite all the hardships and misfortunes, he tries to cope with life and reach for his dreams.

programme.title: Skyline Cruisers
programme.desc: Four professional thieves are tasked with stealing a cancer vaccine, but they are shocked to discover a pre-set bomb in the laboratory and realize it is a setup against them. Suddenly, a mysterious girl appears, holding a crucial clue that could unravel the conspiracy...

programme.title: Face to Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. At Tamotsus funeral, Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man and that is only the beginning of an evil downfall for him

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: Triad boss Song seeks to whitewash his image and seize Laikas mayoral seat amid a regime change. He faces a funding shortfall despite colluding with officials, and gets his right-hand man and enforcer to commit crimes to boost his funds and power. Just as Song believes success is imminent, the dynamics between the three take an unexpected turn

programme.title: Fate Jealous Greed
programme.desc: The film consists of three short horror stories: a man tries to survive after he received a haunted mail predicting his death while a man mourns the death of his beloved wife, she becomes a ghost and tries to communicate with him three brothers clash over the care options of their elderly mother during dinner, leading to a terrifying murder.

programme.title: Lets Make Laugh
programme.desc: When a young housewifes debt-ridden, philandering husband leaves her with a mountain of tax debts, a security guard is hired by the tax authority to guard the assets, but he starts falling for her instead.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: As the police investigate a gang murder case, another mysterious paper man murder occurs, and the suspects are killed one by one. Continuing to track the clues of the case, the police finally unveil a hidden secret and tragedy spanning two generations.

programme.title: Hidden Heroine
programme.desc: A drug cartel is entrenched in the Dong Zhou area. Mei Jing of the Thunderbolt Womens Commando Unit, leads her team to attack the drug base, but they are being ambushed and the identity of Meis father as an undercover is exposed. After a fierce battle, Mei and her team manage to successfully defeat the drug cartel and rescue her father.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: Talented boxer Jia Yang is caught in an underground fight to clear her fathers debts. She loses her Olympic aspiration and vanishes from the boxing world. 10 years later, Coach Li Yue is determined to help her honour her fathers wish by returning to the ring. As passion and obligation collide, can Jia Yang revive her abandoned boxing dream?

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto. Who is the real King of Thieves?

programme.title: Unmatchable Match
programme.desc: Undercover cop Lang is assigned to befriend former triad boss Fei in order to investigate a diamond heist masterminded by the ruthless gangster Big Mad. When the deal goes awry and the diamonds end up in Feis possession, Big Mad comes after them with a vengeance, forcing Lang and Fei to join forces as an unlikely bond begins to form between them.

(尊敬的厨师、农夫、作家、企业家、澳大利亚深爱的一家餐馆Chat Thai、Palisa Anderson等一家商家的母子,对于许多人来说都是很多事情。 但是,问她什么将她的心与一切联系起来,她会简单地回答真实的、好的食物。 她长大后的泰国文化原则一再受到Nahm Jai原则的影响。)

programme.title: 太平年 Swords Into PlowShares

programme.title: 半熟戀人 第4季 Love Actually Season 4 Repackaged

programme.title: 緣來不晚 第4季 Love Never Comes Late Season 4

programme.title: 一夢如初短劇 A Dream LikeTheTrue Love Mini drama

programme.title: 兄弟帮 Big Boys Club

programme.title: 爱．回家之三代同糖 Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: 公关女皇唐万里吴若希饰独力照顾Gen Z女儿唐芯李茵彤饰，控制欲极强万里的母亲唐曹嘉冰车婉婉饰半生相夫教子，忽然觉醒，由加拿大返港，决心寻回失落时光，更搬入万里家中当年嘉冰曾因万里坚持未婚生下女儿，母女彻底闹僵，如今嘉冰却突然无预警杀入及扰乱万里的生活万里力图维持秩序，唐芯则周旋两人之间，三代同堂火花四溅，矛盾不断职场上，富二代老板空降营销大神杨帆赵浚承饰，与万里平起平坐正面交锋，万里事业与家庭同时迎来危机.

programme.title: 夫妻的博弈 Mrs. Revenge
programme.desc: 善良的幸如高海宁饰，活于丈夫施继威张颕康饰的压榨下，罹患绝症她撞破丈夫与唯一闺蜜潘雪文郭柏妍饰的奸情，争执间被推出马路惨遭车撞然而，幸如突然醒来，发现一切似乎只是场梦但当梦中场景接连应验，她意识到这或是预知梦为改写命运，幸如决心扭转梦中的悲剧幸如不仅要摆脱渣男与假闺蜜，更设法撮合二人，让雪文接手其原本的不幸她又善用梦境记忆换上亮丽外型，在职场力争上游，还和并肩作战的上司叶家谦马国明饰渐生情愫，最终开拓幸福人生！.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 王老虎抢亲 Bride For A Ride, A
programme.desc: 有勇无谋的王老虎钱嘉乐受不了母亲刘并蒂黄淑仪不时催婚的压力，误把男扮女装的周文宾陈键锋抢回府中作妻，卤莽把他暂置在亲妹王秀英胡定欣的闺房过了一夜，老虎为保妹妹名节，只好让文宾与秀英定亲，并立下苛刻规条折辱文宾；天资聪颖的文宾为求脱困，施计利用屠龙女侠武三娘苏玉华制衡老虎，误导三娘以为老虎正是她苦思多年的救命恩人，又设局让老虎再次抢亲，抢了三娘回府，二人成亲后，三娘为教好这只恶老虎，天天在王府上演驯悍记，把性情爆裂的老虎差点气疯；文宾成功脱离虎爪本应逍遥自在，却因自负强出头而掀起连场风波当中人物情节皆一改传统剧目的固有步法，为王老虎抢亲谱出崭新局面.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 情逆三世缘 Always and Ever
programme.desc: 因一句锥心誓言，情报科督察袁金昌欧阳震华错手杀害女友杨夕雪关咏荷在伤心欲绝之际，金昌灵魂出窍穿越时空回到宋代，依附在开封府尹包拯欧阳震华身上，并惊见与夕雪相同样貌的韩霜霜关咏荷出现眼前包拯查明霜霜身世原为公主，却被奸人高继安黄智贤陷害，包拯被逼挥泪斩霜霜，灵魂亦再度出窍落到50年代，成为叱咤一时的华龙飙欧阳震华探长在宿世姻缘安排下，他以为自己再遇夕雪，眼前人田秋凤关咏荷却对龙飙毫无记忆，反视他为杀夫仇人龙飙为摆脱宿命，不断探查真相，意外得知跳舞女郎林艳芳（朱晨丽）和其男友袁规（敖嘉年）是自己亲生父母，而所有阴谋却是田秋凤之妹田秋雁（黄智雯）一手安排悲剧再度发生，龙飙再次意外害死秋凤金昌灵魂返回现代，为保护夕雪，为逃出怨咒，他决意找出转世施咒的人，但却惊悉自己就是一切悲剧的始作俑者.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: 刀下留人 Executioner, The
programme.desc: 杀人无数的刽子手叶常绿黄德斌为保护恩公的媳妇阮素心姚子羚顺利产子，将素心安顿在京城享负盛名的稳婆花蕊红邵美琪家中，因而遇上离奇命案，常绿竟以其鬼头刀救活了一条小生命，谁料这名来历不明的男婴令常绿和蕊红无故卷入朝廷的政治漩涡，一冷一热的配搭化解了一次又一次的危机，两人在患难中渐生情愫；另边厢，一对同在妓院长大的小情侣赤知秋杨明和祝小满龚嘉欣来到蕊红家，苦苦哀求常绿收知秋为刽子手的学徒，知秋其心不正，只想藉此逃脱受刑，常绿迟疑不决，一名神秘的彩戏师司马丑陈山聪出现，令各人关系陷入错综复杂，男婴身分之谜更因而被逐步揭开，但同时敲起了死神的丧钟.

programme.title: 兄弟 Fist Fight
programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.desc: 来自英国的保镖主管夏天行杨明，到港后奉命保护网络教主张非凡王浩信，顺道寻觅身世线索非凡行事张狂，还藉举办拳赛掩护窃密黑客赴港，期间屡遇险境麻烦，幸得天行一一化解事件引来火爆刑警何铁男伍允龙关注，决心全力追查原来铁男曾因一时冲动犯下不可告人的过失，性格亦渐走偏锋拳赛同时激发三人的好战天性，他们又逐渐发现彼此拥有相同的感应能力，藉以互助互救而三人背后的隐密连系，更牵涉逾二十年前的金融风暴之战.

programme.title: 巨轮 Brothers Keeper
programme.desc: 乔天生（陈展鹏饰）和罗威信（萧正楠饰）是同母异父的亲兄弟，因为命运令他们不单分开在香港和澳门两地，更令他们尝尽剧变历史中的两极冲突 母亲周玉梅（李司棋饰）带着小儿子威信在澳门当黑市居民，威信凭着努力和好朋友姚文英（田蕊妮饰）与龙飞（阮兆祥饰）的相助，历尽艰辛，克服挑战，最终踏上成功之路独自在港自食其力的天生却改走快捷方式，联结黑道古惑仔姜勇（张继聪饰），与富家女发生关系，令女友卓静（钟嘉欣饰）伤心欲绝，最终落得人财两空 本是唇齿相依的手足情，经历时代巨轮的洗礼，前境变幻莫测，二人愈走愈远，但一个信念深植在他们相连的血脉里，纵然考验再苦再难，终在一条又新又活的道路上重遇.

programme.title: 我瞒结婚了 Married But Available
programme.desc: 一场意外，令情侣欧阳梓聪及朱明明决定结婚不过，明明为免得失老板施露嘉，只得隐瞒已婚；同时，梓聪被大学同学张展博邀请，加入露嘉的公司，密谋重夺展博父张建国所创的金行业务这对隐婚夫妻被迫在公司内对立，渐生矛盾此外，展博与明明发现十分有缘，暗恋梓聪十多年的纪文意，亦令梓聪抵受不了诱惑，一对夫妻各自展开婚外情明明决定分居后，梓聪却看到展博的事业诡计，加以阻止，更惹明明讨厌，两人的关系有否转机？.

programme.title: 妳不是她 Youre Just Not Her
programme.desc: 食品公司销售经理林信丁子朗饰时装店老板夏莉冯盈盈饰同居多时，爱情渐变平淡，两人对将来也存在分歧情侣间日积月累的矛盾不满一发不可收拾，林信夏莉爆发激烈争吵下引致车祸经历生死一剎后，踏实贤淑的夏莉变得热情率性，事事以林信为中心，甚至介入其圈子，为林信的姊姊林善车婉婉饰上司麦美娜姚嘉妮饰竞敌骆伟滔张颕康饰好兄弟穆家杰马贯东饰和区文黄庭锋饰带来巨大冲击！林信纵跟夏莉重拾初相识的浪漫与情愫，但眼前的她犹如判若两人，林信不禁思疑对方还是否真爱？.

programme.title: Mr Millennium
programme.desc: Keriuhan suara orang kampung mencari Jamil dan Mastora membuatkan Jamil dan Mastora yang baru masuk semula ke zaman sebenar mereka terjaga. Mereka pandang sekeliling dan terpinga-pinga kerana tidak yakin apa yang mereka lalui tadi. Jamil tengok sekelilingnya hutan, dia tiba-tiba rasa gembira sebab dah kembali pada asal. Orang kampung menjumpai Jamil dan Mastora di hutan itu dan membawa mereka pulang. Malam itu di rumah Jamil, penduduk kampung datang ke rumah Jamil silih berganti. Mereka semua tercengang mendengar hebatnya berada di zaman moden dengan kecanggihan yang melampau seperti yang diceritakan oleh Jamil.

programme.title: Superhero Hati
programme.desc: Mujur Adam ditemui kira-kira setengah selepas itu. Rupanya Adam merajuk dengan Akasyah yang lambat datang mengambilnya di sekolah, membuatkan dia ambil keputusan untuk jalan kaki pulang ke rumah. Suhana yang baru mula bertugas di tadika Adam pula terpempan apabila Adam lari keluar kelas apabila dia menyuruh muridmurid kelas Adam membuat kad hari ibu. Setelah disiasat, Suhana merasa terkejut dan sedih setelah mengetahui Adam telah kematian ibu dan hanya dibesarkan oleh nenek dan bapanya. Ini membuatkan Suhana menumpukan lebih perhatian kepada Adam, sehingga Adam memanggilnya mama.

programme.title: Bayangan Cinta
programme.desc: Pertemuan dua bekas kekasih, Auzy dan Akhbar selepas 18 tahun membangkitkan perasaan lama. programme.title: Suci Dalam Debu
programme.desc: Roy, seorang anak kaya yang ingin berkawan dengan pemuzik bertemu Rina di sebuah kelab malam. Namun, Rina telah ditunangkan dengan Tengku Johan oleh bapanya, Tengku Aziz. Tengku Johan ingin mempercepatkan tarikh perkahwinan mereka kerana ingin memiliki Rina. Roy telah dicabar dan diletakkan taruhan oleh Tengku Johan jika benar dia boleh mendapatkan Rina.

programme.title: Si Jantung Hati
programme.desc: Dua adik beradik, Do dan Re, keluar menggembara untuk mencari harta pusaka kepunyaan ayah mereka yang telah lama disembunyikan. Sebelum itu, mereka perlu mencari sahabat lama ayah mereka yang mempunyai petunjuk lokasi harta itu. Tetapi sesuatu terjadi apabila musuh lama muncul kembali untuk mengambil harta pusaka itu kerana yakin bahawa itu miliknya yang telah dicuri ayah mereka bertahun-tahun dahulu.

programme.title: Antara Dua Hati
programme.desc: Datin Sharifah ialah seorang balu yang mempunyai dua orang anak remaja, Shah dan Ina. Shah mempunyai seorang teman wanita berbangsa Cina yang bernama Linda dan Ina pula bercinta dengan Johari. Dalam satu kemalangan, Datin Sharifah telah berkenalan dengan Jefri, seorang penyanyi kelab malam. Hubungan mereka kemudiannya menjadi semakin intim. Dalam masa yang sama, Ina pula jatuh cinta dengan Jefri.

programme.title: Operasi Cegah Jenayah
programme.desc: Dua orang anggota polis, Shah dan Din telah ditugaskan untuk mengawasi satu pertunjukan permata berlian yang bernilai jutaan ringgit. Pihak penganjur juga meminta mereka berdua menjaga para peragawati mereka yang sedang bercuti daripada pertunjukan itu. Dalam masa yang sama, Crystal yang menjadi pengurus agensi peragawati itu merancang satu rompakan barangan berharga yang berada dalam pengawasan Shah dan Din.

programme.title: Sindrom Mana Anakku
programme.desc: Dr. Kamal dan Dr. Lisa bekerja di hospital yang sama. Dr. Kamal keluar mendapat panggilan kecemasan di sebuah rumah. Dibawa pesakit tersebut ke hospital kerana kemungkinan komplikasi kelahiran namun mula tertanya-tanya di manakah anaknya. Anak pesakit tersebut perlu dicari sebelum apa-apa berlaku kepadanya.

programme.title: Manis Manis Sayang
programme.desc: Terkesan dengan tingkah laku Bahadom terhadapnya di khalayak ramai, Jalil membuat keputusan untuk berhenti bekerja. Namun Bahadom mempunyai rancangan lain apabila Datuk menyuruhnya untuk mencari seorang pegawai untuk dihantar ke luar negara. Kerana bencikan Jalil dan juga ingin memisahkannya dari Rosnah, Bahadom mahu menghantar Jalil ke luar negara.

programme.title: Bisikan Remaja
programme.desc: Ameera yang baru berpindah dari Sabah ke Kuala Lumpur bersekolah di kolej swasta, dan dipilih sebagai ketua kelas. Rakan-rakan Daniel bagaimanapun merasakan bahawa Daniel, sebagai ahli sukan kolej, lebih layak untuk jawatan itu. Ketidakpuasan hati ini memecahkan kelas kepada dua puak. Ameera semakin popular kerana kecantikan, kecerdasan dan personalitinya. Daniel membuat taruhan dengan rakan-rakannya, bahawa dia akan dapat memenangi hati Ameera dalam masa dua minggu. Apabila Ameera mengetahui tentang pertaruhan itu, dia dan Daniel menjadi musuh, walaupun telah membina perasaan bersama antara satu sama lain.

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cowo
programme.desc: Mengisahkan dari sudut pandang Kelvin, seorang lelaki yang cuba memahami pasangannya, Mila, menjelang hari perkahwinan mereka. Perbezaan cara berfikir, komunikasi dan harapan antara lelaki dan wanita mencetuskan pelbagai konflik serta situasi lucu. Filem ini menggambarkan bagaimana pasangan perlu memahami, bertolak ansur dan menerima kekurangan masing-masing dalam membina hubungan yang lebih erat.

programme.title: Ruang Temu
programme.desc: Program temu bual bersama Tony Eusoff yang mengupas pengalaman peribadi beliau berkaitan pengalaman beliau di dalam industri seni

programme.title: Mars Met Venus Part Cewe
programme.desc: Mengisahkan tentang Mila, seorang wanita yang mempunyai pandangan tersendiri mengenai hubungan dan cinta, yang berdepan dengan perbezaan cara berfikir antara lelaki dan wanita. Melalui kisah percintaan Mila dan Kelvin, filem ini memaparkan konflik, salah faham serta sisi lucu dalam hubungan pasangan sebelum melangkah ke alam perkahwinan.

programme.title: Mikado
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Mikado dan Laetitia, pasangan yang hidup bersama anak-anak mereka, Nuage dan Zphir, dengan cara hidup bebas di dalam van sambil mendidik anak-anak mereka sendiri. Apabila van mereka rosak, mereka terpaksa tinggal sementara di sebuah rumah bersama Vincent dan anak perempuannya. Perubahan gaya hidup ini mula menguji hubungan keluarga, membuka kisah silam serta memaksa mereka memahami erti kestabilan, kasih sayang dan kebahagiaan sebenar.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. Namun apabila bekas suaminya Remy Ishak kembali untuk menuntut tanah warisan, kejadian-kejadian aneh mula menghantui kampung mereka, memaksa keluarga itu berdepan dengan rahsia silam yang selama ini tersembunyi. Tayangan Perdana ini menampilkan babak pembukaan Bisikan Pontianak, bersama rakaman eksklusif di sebalik tabir dan treler rasmi.

programme.title: Pintu Surga Terakhir
programme.desc: Irma, seorang wanita karier yang sukses dan banyak menolak lamaran lelaki demi menjaga ayahnya yang ia anggap sebagai pintu menuju surga selepas kematian ibunya. Suatu hari, tanpa sengaja dia bertemu kembali dengan Yusuf, seorang fotografer dari masa lalunya yang menghilang tanpa kabar. Pertemuan itu membangkitkan kembali hubungan mereka, tetapi Irma harus memilih antara cinta dan tanggungjawabnya terhadap ayahnya yang semakin tua.

programme.title: Pelangi Yang Hilang
programme.desc: Cikgu Lutfi yang baru ditukarkan ke sekolah berusaha membantu Hadi dan adiknya yang kematian ibu, tetapi konflik timbul apabila ibu saudara mereka kembali dan menimbulkan masalah keluarga

programme.title: Langit
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Raziah, seorang suri rumah yang menjadi wanita berdikari dan penyara keluarga selepas kematian suaminya. Tidak mahu pasrah, Raziah berusaha mencari pekerjaan dan membina kejayaan demi memulihkan rasa hormat komuniti terhadapnya.

programme.title: KIL
programme.desc: Akil, seorang pemuda yang bergelut dengan kemurungan, berkali-kali gagal membunuh diri. Hidupnya berubah apabila dia secara tidak sengaja menyelamatkan seorang gadis yang cuba terjun kerana putus cinta. Suatu hari, dia menemui risalah menawarkan khidmat bunuh diri dan menghubungi Salina, yang membawanya kepada sebuah agensi misteri bernama Life Action Bureau LAB. Di bawah bimbingan konsultan LAB, Encik Harun, Akil mengupah mereka untuk membunuhnya namun dengan syarat dia tidak akan tahu siapa pembunuhnya, bila, atau bagaimana dia akan menemui ajalnya. Segala-galanya kini menjadi permainan maut yang penuh teka-teki.

programme.title: Tayangan Perdana Bisikan Pontianak
programme.desc: Selepas ditinggalkan suaminya, Suraya Diana Danielle membesarkan dua orang anaknya sendirian di sebuah rumah terpencil. programme.title: Bopeng
programme.desc: Bo Nabil Ahmad dan Peng Johan Asari ialah dua sahabat baik yang bekerja di Opiel Secret Pizza. Kehidupan mereka berubah apabila pelanggan tetap, Mira Idora Senrose, menelefon meminta tolong selepas diikuti dan diculik seorang lelaki misteri. Menggunakan kepintaran dan pengalaman membaca novel jenayah, Peng memberi arahan kepada Mira untuk menyelamatkan diri dari but kereta. Bersama Bo dan bantuan pihak polis, mereka menjejaki Mira melalui petunjuk unik seperti cat di jalan raya. Namun, musuh yang bijak sentiasa selangkah di hadapan, menjadikan misi menyelamatkan Mira penuh cabaran dan tegang.

programme.title: Ketika Cinta Bertasbih
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Azzam, seorang pemuda yang berpegang teguh pada nilai-nilai Islam, berusaha menuntut ilmu sambil mengekalkan cinta kepada Tsuraya. Mereka menghadapi pelbagai ujian, konflik keluarga, dan rintangan sosial, namun keyakinan dan keimanan membimbing mereka menempuh cabaran cinta dan kehidupan.

programme.title: Rock Oo
programme.desc: Sekuel kepada Rock, filem ini mengisahkan kumpulan rock Rimba Bara yang bersatu semula untuk mengejar impian muzik dan kembali ke pentas utama di tengah pelbagai cabaran serta gelak-ketawa.

programme.title: Rock 4 - Rockers Never Dai
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Dio, bekas anggota kumpulan rock legenda Rimba Bara, yang terjaga selepas bertahun-tahun koma akibat kemalangan. Berdepan dengan perubahan zaman dan industri muzik yang semakin berubah, Dio berusaha menghidupkan kembali legasi Rimba Bara dengan menubuhkan kumpulan baharu, Rimba Bara 2, bersama barisan pemuzik muda. Namun, perjalanan mereka untuk mengembalikan kegemilangan muzik rock penuh dengan cabaran dan persaingan

programme.desc: Anjani berkahwin dengan Ammar melalui perkahwinan yang diatur, namun malangnya Ammar tidak mencintai Anjani, terutamanya selepas mengetahui bahawa Anjani sukar untuk hamil. Akhirnya, Anjani mengambil anak angkat yang ternyata mempunyai rahsia masa lalu dalam kehidupan suaminya.

programme.title: Doyan Makan
programme.desc: Doyan Makan menjemput penonton untuk mengikuti perjalanan dan pengalaman kulinari untuk makanan popular di kawasan tersebut, serta akan meninjau informasi tentang tempat, harga dan proses penghasilan makanan yang mereka nikmati.

programme.title: Wanita Istimewa
programme.desc: Mirsa Alisia Rininta dan Radit Reuben Elishama hidup sederhana di Padang sehingga satu kesilapan besar berlaku apabila Radit tanpa sedar membawa beg berisi dadah. Untuk melindungi suaminya, Mirsa menyerah diri dan dipenjara selama tujuh tahun, manakala bayi yang dilahirkannya terpaksa diserahkan kepada ibu mertuanya untuk dijaga. Selepas dibebaskan, Mirsa mencari keluarganya tetapi mendapati Radit sudah berpindah ke Jakarta. Jejak itu membawa Mirsa ke sebuah acara pelancaran perumahan di mana dia bertemu semula dengan Radit yang kini bersama isterinya Karina Naomi Zaskia dan berkenalan dengan Reza Randy Pangalila, sementara tekanan daripada Pramana Adipura terhadap perkahwinan mereka mula terbongkar.

programme.title: Siapa Takut Orang Ketiga
programme.desc: Kimi tiba di Swiss untuk memulakan hidup barunya dan di sana dia berkenalan dengan William, seorang pelajar Indonesia yang sedang menyelesaikan pengajiannya. William membantu Kimi mendapatkan pekerjaan. Samuel, sahabat Kimi di Indonesia, merasakan Kimi semakin dekat dengan William. Namun, Kimi menyangkal perkara itu. Hakikatnya, Kimi telah menyimpan perasaan kepada Samuel sejak lama.

programme.title: POV Disekop-Sekop Cogan 34M Followers
programme.desc: Echa, seorang gadis kampung, sangat meminati Tristan, selebriti media sosial yang terkenal. programme.title: Rindu Bukan Rindu

programme.desc: Sebuah siri separa dokumentari yang menyeronokkan dan dikendalikan oleh sekumpulan hos cilik yang penuh tenaga. programme.desc: Dokumentari separa realiti yang meneroka Minang, sebuah wilayah di Indonesia yang terkenal sebagai Tanah Para Pedagang.

programme.title: Cinta Tak Kasat Mata
programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang gadis cantik bernama Marsha yang sering dihantui oleh Vino, seorang lelaki misteri yang tidak kelihatan oleh orang lain. Vino adalah mangsa pertikaian asmara yang menyebabkan kematiannya. Walaupun Marsha merasa takut pada awalnya, Vino terus membantu Marsha. Namun, Marsha mulai ragu jika Vino memang wujud atau hanya ilusi.

programme.title: A REASON TO LIVE (生命的理由)
programme.desc: TV producer Da-hye lost her fianc in an accident. She forgave the young criminal and moved on. A year later, she starts filming a documentary on forgiveness and is shocked to find out... (电视制作人达赫在事故中失去了她的未婚夫.她原谅了年轻罪犯,然后继续前进.一年后,她开始拍摄关于宽恕的纪录片,)

programme.title: THE ATTORNEY ((地狱里长))
programme.desc: When tax attorney Song Woo-Suk agrees to defend a student activist who was arrested and tortured into giving a false confession, his entire life and worldview begin to change drastically. (当税务律师伍苏克同意捍卫一名被捕并被折磨为假承认的学生活动人士时,)

programme.title: OKAY! MADAM ((OK老板娘))
programme.desc: A married couple unwittingly becomes involved in a rescue operation of a hijacked aircraft during their first-ever family trip abroad to Hawaii. (一对夫妇在第一次出国旅行中,未知地参与了劫机飞机的救援行动.)

programme.title: HITMAN: AGENT JUN ((漫画威龙之大话特务))
programme.desc: While under the influence of alcohol, an unsuccessful comic book writer draws a comic about his life as a former NIS hitman, and runs into trouble when it gets posted online. (一位失败的漫画作家在酒精的影响下画了一幅漫画,讲述了他作为前NIS杀手的人生,)

programme.title: 645: LUCKY LOTTO (六百四十五章: 幸运的)
programme.desc: The excitement of winning a lottery ticket doesnt last long for sergeant Chun-woo as it accidentally ends up crossing the Military Demarcation Line. He must get his act together and find it again! (军官伍的乐趣不久就会在胜利的场合,因为它会偶然地过渡军事界限.)

programme.title: THE KINGS LETTERS ((国之语音))
programme.desc: King Sejong desires to create an original alphabet for his people. With the help of others, they struggle to create the Korean alphabet Hangul. (随着其他人的帮助,他们努力创造韩国字母汉古尔.)

programme.title: DOUBLE PATTY ((双层肉排))
programme.desc: An aspiring news anchor and a struggling wrestler meets by chance at a burger joint. Through shared meals, they encourage each other to reach for their dreams! (一位有志成为新闻主播和一个扎的摔手偶然在汉堡店见面.)

programme.title: ROOM NO. 7 ((7号室))
programme.desc: Doo-sik, a failing DVD room owner, and Tae-jung, a debt-ridden student, each hide some secrets in Room No. 7 of the store, sparking a darkly comic clash of secrets and survival. (杜,一个失败的DVD房主,和泰,一个债务的学生,)

programme.title: MY PUPPY ((秘密的恋爱))
programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy. (一位新郎和朋友一起去找一个新主人给他的狗.)

programme.title: THE ROUNDUP: NO WAY OUT (没有办法出门)
programme.desc: There is a drug case links to an organized crime organization in Japan. Despite the expanding scale of the case, the beast cop and his team strive their best to arrest the criminal... (尽管案件规模不断扩大,野兽警察和他的团队尽最大努力逮捕犯罪者...)

programme.title: PRETTY CRAZY ((容祖儿 PRETTY CRAZY 演唱会 嘉宾篇))
programme.desc: Gil-gu falls for his new neighbor, Sun-ji. She is sweet by day but appears uncanny at night. He later learns that there is a devil inside her and wants to unravel her curse. (吉尔古爱上了他的新邻居孙.她白天很甜,但夜晚看起来很奇怪.他后来发现她内心有魔鬼,想解开她的诅咒.)

programme.title: ROAD TO BOSTON ((1947波士顿))
programme.desc: A group of marathoners want to run proudly under the Korean flag after Koreas liberation. Though they couldnt afford a pair of sneakers, they embark on an unforgettable journey to Boston. (虽然他们买不起一双运动鞋,但他们开始了难忘的旅程到波士顿.)

programme.title: HELLO GHOST ((开心家族))
programme.desc: After many failed suicide attempts, a man discovers he can see a family of ghosts. The ghosts agree to leave him alone under the condition that he fulfill their requests.

programme.title: A MELODY TO REMEMBER ((想念哥哥))
programme.desc: Amidst the Korean War in 1952, Lt. Han Sang-Ryul formed a choir with the orphaned refugee children in Busan, finding solace and purpose through music, despite the hardships of war.

programme.title: ACTIONHERO ((动作英雄))
programme.desc: A college student dreaming to be an action star discovered an admission fraud. He decided to make an action film of him against the corrupted professor. (一位梦想成为动作明星的大学生发现了招生欺诈行为,)

programme.title: THE ROUNDUP: NO WAY OUT (没有办法出门)
programme.desc: There is a drug case links to an organized crime organization in Japan. Despite the expanding scale of the case, the beast cop and his team strive their best to arrest the criminal... (尽管案件规模不断扩大,野兽警察和他的团队尽最大努力逮捕犯罪者...)

programme.title: DONT GO TOO FAR (不要太远)
programme.desc: While arguing on the division of their fathers ?2B inheritance, the eldest brother received a call to realize his son was kidnapped, and the ransom demanded was ?2B...

programme.title: MY PUPPY ((秘密的恋爱))
programme.desc: A groom-to-be sets off with his friend to finding a new owner for his puppy. (一位新郎和朋友一起去找一个新主人给他的狗.)

programme.title: PRETTY CRAZY ((容祖儿 PRETTY CRAZY 演唱会 嘉宾篇))
programme.desc: Gil-gu falls for his new neighbor, Sun-ji. She is sweet by day but appears uncanny at night. He later learns that there is a devil inside her and wants to unravel her curse. (吉尔古爱上了他的新邻居孙.她白天很甜,但夜晚看起来很奇怪.他后来发现她内心有魔鬼,想解开她的诅咒.)

programme.title: HI-FIVE
programme.desc: Five strangers gain organs and superpowers from a mysterious donor. United by markings, they clash as a team while a cult leader hunts them to steal their powers and achieve immortality.

programme.title: KILLING ROMANCE ((大内密探之姻缘劫))
programme.desc: As a popular actress has growing discontentment towards her marriage, she begins planning to kill her rich husband with her neighbor. (由于一个受欢迎的女演员对她的婚姻越来越不满,)

programme.title: MAMA ((妈妈))
programme.desc: A story of Dong-sook, a mom with incurable illness and her son has fatal disease, Eun-sook, whose dreams eclipsed by her mom and Seung-chul, a gangster tries to find his moms first love. (故事讲述了东苏克,一个母亲患有不可治愈的疾病,她的儿子患有致命的疾病, 苏克,她的梦想被她的母亲和楚尔罩着,)

programme.title: IN OUR PRIME ((普通男女))
programme.desc: Genius Mathematician defected from the North tried to hide his past eventually started teaching a student who gave up on Maths the right way to find the answer. (流派的数学家从北方试图隐藏自己的过去,最终开始教一个放弃数学的学生找到正确的答案.)

programme.title: World of Street Woman Fighter
programme.desc: The Street Woman Fighter series make a triumphant return on a global stage! 6 dance crews from different countries set to compete in an upgraded match to win the title of International Champion!

programme.title: You Can Cook With Sam Kim ((金喜泰))
programme.desc: Star chef Sam Kim will teach you how to make all kinds of delicious dishes - from Italian pasta, Spanish food to desserts! Follow his easy recipes and enjoy cooking! (星级厨师Sam Kim将教你如何做各种美味的菜 - - 从意大利面,西班牙菜到甜点!)

programme.title: Fresh Off the Sea 3 ((姐姐家的产地直送 3))
programme.desc: The cast travels to new locations to experience seaside life, working at local jobs and cooking authentic meals with fresh, seasonal ingredients in this heartwarming reality show. (演员们前往新的地方, 经历海生活, 在当地工作,)

programme.title: Space Rice Cake ((宇宙年糕店))

programme.title: Scoop 2026 ((2026年全国两会))
programme.desc: Scoop airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The Todays Breaking News segment keeps viewers up to date with the days hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights. (苏普在周一到周日播出,密切关注主要社会事件和有趣的故事,同时还报道了娱乐行业的最新更新,名人新闻,以及戏剧促销和幕后特色.今天 Breaking News 分类让观众了解最热门的故事.深入的特色部分探讨了公众关心的当前事件,社会和生计问题,采访相关专家以获取他们的见解.)

programme.title: Hipster Tour - South America Sr.2 ((南美潮什么 Sr.2))
programme.desc: Christy Leung restarts her South American journey, unlocking more Latin American countries and experiencing all four seasons in one trip! Stroll along Argentinas World Heritage glaciers and sample whiskey infused with glacial ice. Discover the idyllic paradise of Patagonia, enjoying its stunning scenery and delicious cuisine. Head to Easter Island in Chile, cycling around the island in search of giant stone statues. Explore the Amazon rainforest, the worlds largest tropical rainforest, with an adventure alongside the indigenous people. Visit the Galapagos Islands in Ecuador, famous for their evolutionary history, and explore their animal ecology. In Colombia, soak in a mud bath, swim in the Caribbean Sea, and visit a floating island in the middle of the ocean to witness the islanders lives.

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace ((100万个约定之宁安如梦))
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning Bai Lu went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-nings wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Weis Zhang Linghe pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin Zhou Junwei from getting involved in the coming-of-age incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Weis strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels scheme. She and Zhang Zhe Wang Xingyue venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi Liu Xening does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness. (江宁·白卢为成为皇帝做了很大的努力.但她被迫在宫殿中自杀.快速前进到现在,江宁的愿望是远离权力斗争,控制她的命运.然而,她仍然是某种程度上进入宫殿作为学习伙伴,成为伟先生的学生.在学习时,江宁阴谋阻止延周军在成年事件中参与.通过遵循江宁和徐伟战略,延们设法保持活着.在成年危机后,江宁无意地卷入了王朝的阴谋与伟王主张强的反抗.然而,她和伟王妃在成年后,最终会在伟王朝的两人之间进行和平,并最终无法在两人之间进行更深入的关系.但在两年后,)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026 ((全信没收))
programme.desc: Big City Shop introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges. (随着大城市商店的推广,观众们可以了解到各种及时的主题,包括季节性产品,健康和健康,健身活动,护肤和化,时尚服装,婴儿护理,家长知识,当地精致食品和物护理趋势.内容是全面的!除了主持人实践示范,体验或测试外,专家也被邀请分享他们的专业见解.在菜领域,几位熟练的菜专家轮流展示简单而美味的健康菜和家庭式食谱,帮助每个人都解决风格的挑战.)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies ((开心老友记))
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the caseolder adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organizations definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate? (许多人可能认为年长者没有性需求,但调查表明,年长者通常因各种原因而没有更多的性活动.社会福利部的临床心理学家林海明解释了世界卫生组织对性行为的定义,并为希望与伴侣重新启动性生活的人提供建议.)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026 ((新闻掏宝 2026))
programme.desc: As the saying goes, Todays news is tomorrows history. With so much news every day, its hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure troveif we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program News Treasure Hunt guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lees funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queens visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Pattens arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences. (据说,今天的新闻是明天的历史.每天有这么多新闻,每个人都很难收录一切,更不用说回顾历史.历史是一个宝藏,如果我们忽视或低估它,我们可能会错过它的财富. 新节目新闻宝藏猎引导观众从这个库中发现新闻宝石.除了特色,直播和过去的系列报道外,该节目还提供了前所未见的宝贵的镜像.观众将有机会重览诸如布鲁斯·李斯银行抢劫,四王妃团审判,香港的访问,出租车罢工,签署中英联合宣言,与玛格丽特·撒切尔的独家采访,越南难民,州长帕特登的死亡,中国航天机场的抵达,中国航天机场的报道)

programme.title: Another Era ((再创世纪))
programme.desc: In 2008, as the tsunami of financial chaos engulfed the world, ambitious entrepreneur HO TIN-SANG Kwok Chun On saw the opportunity seeking to take over the richest man in Hong Kong, FONG CHUNG-YAMs Wu Fung business empire, but was interfered by another business magnate CHEUK KAI-TONG Pat Poon. Bearing animosity towards him, TIN-SANG has been seeking revenge since then. Ten years later, the now wealthiest Cheuk family is overshadowed by misfortune. The sudden death of KAI-TONGs son comes as a crushing blow to KAI-TONG, who lapses into a coma after a heart attack. To keep their business going, his inexperienced younger daughter CHEUK DING-YIU Chow Lai Ki, Niki, with the help of a private equity placement agent, KO CHIT Frankie Lam, faces off with TIN-SANG. With KAI-TONG regaining consciousness, TIN-SANGs wife CHEUNG MING-HEI Tavia Yeung, CHUNG-YAMs grandson FONG CHAK-YU Benjamin Yuen and aspiring young entrepreneur CHING HOI Chau Pak Ho also get involved in the ever-escalating power struggle. The enmity among them will soon intensify towards a full-blown rivalry (2008年,随着金融混乱的海淹没世界,雄心勃勃的企业家霍廷山·库克春· (Ho Tin-Sang Kwok Chun On) 看到机会寻求接管香港最富有的人,春的武功商业帝国,但被另一位商界巨头克凯·普恩干预.他对他的仇恨,桑一直在寻求报复.十年后,现在最富有的克家族被不幸所遮蔽.凯的儿子突然去世是对凯的压倒性打击,他因心脏病发作而昏迷.为了让他们的业务继续前进,他的未经验的年轻女儿克戴,小·,与私人代理人克,克和克,克-克,克)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEIs home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEIs life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, Marketing Guru YEUNG FAN Gary Chiu, is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEIs career and family are facing crises at the same time. (公共关系女王曼丽·金尼·恩独自抚养她的Z代女儿姆·杜斯塔·李,她是一个控制怪物.姆·李的母亲乔·卡·比恩·斯蒂芬·,她已经花了一半的生命支持丈夫和抚养他们的孩子.她突然醒来,她从加拿大返回香港.她决定恢复失去了时间,她搬到曼丽的家.多年前,卡·比恩和她的女儿完全失去了,因为曼丽坚持让她的女儿离婚.现在,卡·比恩突然突破了没有警告并破坏了曼丽的生活.曼丽努力保持秩序,而姆·李在这两人之间,创造了平等的职业和家庭冲突.在这三个代家庭中,他不断地陷入危机,在这个繁荣的工作中,)

programme.title: Walking With You ((仨心友行))
programme.desc: Sharon Chan, Samantha Ko, Katy Kung, and Grace Chan are close friends in the entertainment industry. This trip to Malaysia was a rare girls getaway, filled with delicious food, fun activities, and experiencing the local culture. During the trip, the four beautiful hosts each invited their friends Lai Lok-yi, Mat Yeung, and Ma Kwun-tung to join them, traveling to Selangor, Pahang, Terengganu, Kelantan, and Sabah. They visited durian orchards to enjoy fresh Musang King durians, picked vegetables and coconuts in vegetable gardens, explored the rainforest, and visited luxurious houses, experiencing a different side of Malaysia. The four friends also shared heartfelt conversations with their guests, revealing their true selves. (沙龙,萨曼塔·科,卡蒂·库恩和格雷斯·是娱乐界的亲密朋友.这次前往马来西亚的旅行是一次罕见的女孩逃生,充满美味的食物,有趣的活动,体验当地文化.在旅行期间,四位美丽的主持人每个人邀请了他们的朋友莱洛基,马特·叶恩和马库恩加入他们,前往塞兰戈尔,帕汉,特伦格努,凯兰坦和萨巴.他们访问了榴树园来享受新鲜的Musan King榴树,在蔬菜园中摘取蔬菜和子,探索雨林,并访问了豪华的房屋,体验了马来西亚的不同面.四位朋友也与他们的客人分享了真诚的对话,揭示了他们的自我.)

programme.title: Mrs. Revenge ((夫妻的博弈))
programme.desc: Kind-hearted Hang-yu Samantha Ko suffers from some terminal illness as she just exists under the tyranny of her husband Sze Kai-wai Jonathan Cheung. She catches her husband having an affair with her only buddy Poon Suet-man Rosita Kwok, and while arguing, she is pushed into the road and tragically hit by a car. However, Hang-yu abruptly wakes up and realizes everything seems to be just a dream. But as the scenes in her dream come true one after another, she thinks this might be a premonition. To rewrite destiny, Hang-yu is determined to turn the bad luck around in her dream. Hang-yu not only wants to get rid of that scumbag and her fake buddy, but also tries to bring the two together so that Suet-man can take over her original misfortune. Moreover, she makes good use of her dream memories and undergoes a glamorous makeover to strive for success in the workplace. She also gradually develops romantic feelings for her boss Yip Ka-him Kenneth Ma, with whom she is fighting side by side, and eventually finds happiness! (善良的心情的杭萨曼塔科患有某种终结性疾病,因为她只是在丈夫谢凯瓦伊乔纳森的暴政下存在.她发现丈夫和她唯一的朋友普恩苏特曼罗西塔·奎克发生了外遇,在争论时,她被推到道路上,并被车车车悲剧地撞击.然而,杭突然醒来,意识到一切似乎只是一个梦.但随着她的梦中的场景逐渐实现,她认为这是一个预见.为了重写命运,杭决心扭转她的梦中的不幸.杭不仅想摆脱那个丑和她的假朋友,而且还试图把两个人一起来,以便苏特曼能够接管她的不幸.她最终在梦中使用自己的梦想,并逐渐发展了幸福感,她和凯瑟琳一起)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter (像母亲,像女儿)
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI Jinny Ng raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM Desta Lee alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEIs mother, TONG CHO KA-BING Stephanie Che, has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly awakened and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada.
